limits: Offline local tarball verification; no registry publication, remote workflow or credential use.
Import/bundle checks do not establish native browser behavior or assistive-technology observations.
Browser examples are finite headless smoke checks on the recorded installed browser; historical qualification evidence remains separate.

types.method: Fail-closed named declaration export scan followed by standalone compiler imports of every discovered name; core/DOM/worker negative contracts compile separately.

differences: Explicit native rebuild; legacy origin is provenance, not native revision.
Native basic-v1 uses NFKC then lowercase; legacy basic-v1 uses NFC, lowercase, NFC.
Native raw token runs start with a letter or number; legacy runs may include leading marks.
Native raveldex-bm25-v1 scores and ranks are independently computed.
Legacy returnFields is a display projection; native originals and phrases require explicit addons.
Legacy queries, worker handles, persisted namespaces and opaque MiniSearch state are not converted.

documentation.nativeQualification: Explicit application fixture declaration checks only this local runtime roundtrip; reading a version is not universal native snapshot qualification.
